title: Validate Sorter Location Records and Lane Status in SSMS
summary: Use the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) in read-only mode to inspect the SorterSweeper Location Model, verify station and location mappings, and interpret LaneStatus for a selected sorter, tipper, hospital, or induction location.
when_to_use: Use this read-only WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) diagnostic when support must validate a SorterSweeper location record, station or cell-code mapping, location category, lane status, or related KeepClose and TipperSelect configuration.
not_for: Do not use this procedure to modify database rows or configuration values.
Do not use this procedure as a physical sorter, AGV, hospital, or tipper recovery procedure.
Do not treat a nullable LoadCategory or AGV-related field as a fault solely because its value is NULL.
Do not use this procedure to infer an undocumented LaneStatus value or an unverified station mapping.

roles_and_responsibilities.responsibility: Perform the read-only inspection in WCS / Helix DB (SSMS), compare the selected location fields, and document the observed mapping and LaneStatus.
Review or investigate missing rows, mapping mismatches, undocumented statuses, or locations that remain Not tracking when expected to participate in sorter operation.

safety_notes: This is a read-only diagnostic. Do not update database or configuration values as part of this procedure.
LaneStatus interpretation is observational: Active is open for use, Bypassed is closed, and Not tracking is excluded from use until it becomes Active or Bypassed.
access_or_tools_needed: Read-only access to the WCS / Helix SorterSweeper database
SorterSweeper Location Model or corresponding location records

access_required: L2_support or L3_support access to WCS / Helix DB (SSMS)
Read-only access to the SorterSweeper database and location records
system_preconditions: A location, station, cell code, lane, or status requiring validation has been identified.
external_references: The associated station mapping, when validating LocationCellCode

visual_references.description: WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) Sorter Sweeper Database Location Model view showing Location, Station, SorterName, LocationCellCode, Zone, Sequence, Lane, LoadCategory, LaneDelay, LaneStatus, LocationType, KeepClose, TipperSelect, and sample rows.

steps.title: Open the SorterSweeper database in SSMS
steps.purpose: Access the live WCS / Helix DB surface that stores the SorterSweeper location records.
steps.instruction: In WCS / Helix DB (SSMS), select the WCS / Helix SorterSweeper database and open the Location Model or its corresponding location records using read-only access.
steps.expected_result: The SorterSweeper location records are available for inspection in SSMS.
steps.healthy_condition: The expected SorterSweeper database and location records are accessible without making changes.
steps.failure_condition: The database or location records are unavailable, access is not read-only, or the expected Location Model cannot be identified.

actions.label: Select SorterSweeper database
actions.exact_action: Open SSMS and select the WCS / Helix SorterSweeper database.

actions.label: Open location records
actions.exact_action: Open the Location Model or its corresponding location records.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the expected SorterSweeper database or Location Model is missing.
Stop if the available access does not provide a read-only inspection path.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The Sorter Sweeper Database contains the Location Model and related location records.
Sorter Sweeper is identified as one of the OptiSweep databases accessed in the WCS database environment.

steps.title: Inspect the location record fields
steps.purpose: Confirm that the selected location record contains the fields needed to validate its station, lane, and control mapping.
steps.instruction: In the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) Location Model records, inspect Location, Station, SorterName, LocationCellCode, Zone, Sequence, Lane, LoadCategory, LaneDelay, LaneStatus, LocationType, KeepClose, and TipperSelect.
steps.expected_result: The selected location row is present and its available fields can be read, including its station, cell code, lane, location type, and lane status.
steps.healthy_condition: The row contains the expected location identity and the relevant fields are populated or explicitly NULL where the source indicates a nullable value.
steps.failure_condition: The expected row is missing, required mapping fields do not identify the location, or a value is present that cannot be interpreted from the documented fields.

actions.label: Review location attributes
actions.exact_action: Inspect Location, Station, SorterName, LocationCellCode, Zone, Sequence, Lane, LoadCategory, LaneDelay, LaneStatus, LocationType, KeepClose, and TipperSelect.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the expected location row is missing.
Do not change a value because it appears NULL; verify whether the field is documented as nullable.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The Location Model includes Station, SorterName, LocationCellCode, Zone, Sequence, Lane, LoadCategory, LaneDelay, LaneStatus, LocationType, KeepClose, and TipperSelect.

steps.title: Validate the location type
steps.purpose: Determine which documented station category the selected location represents.
steps.instruction: In the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) location record, inspect LocationType and compare it with the documented categories: Sorter, Tipper, Hospital, or Induction.
steps.expected_result: LocationType identifies the selected location as Sorter, Tipper, Hospital, or Induction.
steps.healthy_condition: The LocationType value matches the intended station category; an Induction location represents the specified tote induction location at the hospital, and a Hospital location represents the specified tote drop-off location.
steps.failure_condition: LocationType is missing, contains an undocumented value, or does not match the intended station category.

actions.label: Check LocationType
actions.exact_action: Confirm that LocationType identifies Sorter, Tipper, Hospital, or Induction.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if LocationType is undocumented or does not match the station mapping.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Locations represent stations in the map and have four types: Sorter, Tipper, Hospital, and Induction.

steps.title: Compare LocationCellCode with the station mapping
steps.purpose: Verify that the location's cell-code identity corresponds to the intended station and supports the documented presence-notification behavior.
steps.instruction: In the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS), compare the selected location's LocationCellCode and Station with the associated station mapping. For an Induction or Hospital location, verify whether the AGV-reported cell code is the same cell code as the location used for the hospital-controller presence notification.
steps.expected_result: The selected LocationCellCode corresponds to the intended Station; for an Induction or Hospital location, the mapping identifies the cell code used for the documented hospital-controller notification behavior.
steps.healthy_condition: LocationCellCode and Station agree with the associated mapping and the location category.
steps.failure_condition: LocationCellCode does not match the station mapping, the mapping is missing, or the location category is inconsistent with the expected notification relationship.

actions.label: Compare cell code and station
actions.exact_action: Compare LocationCellCode with the associated station mapping.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if LocationCellCode does not match the station mapping.
Escalate if an Induction or Hospital location cannot be associated with the expected cell-code relationship.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: LocationCellCode identifies the station cell; when an AGV reports the same cell code as an Induction or Hospital location, the hospital controller is notified of the AGV presence.
Cell codes correspond to RMS node-code terminology and are used as location identifiers.

steps.title: Interpret LaneStatus
steps.purpose: Determine whether the selected lane or location is open, closed, or excluded from use according to the live database state.
steps.instruction: In the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) location record, inspect LaneStatus and record whether it is Active, Bypassed, or Not tracking.
steps.expected_result: LaneStatus displays one of the documented values and support records the corresponding operational interpretation.
steps.healthy_condition: Active indicates the lane is open for use; Bypassed indicates the lane is closed; Not tracking indicates the location is excluded from use until it becomes Active or Bypassed.
steps.failure_condition: LaneStatus contains an undocumented value, or the location remains Not tracking when it is expected to participate in sorter operation.

actions.label: Read lane status
actions.exact_action: Inspect LaneStatus and record whether the location is Active, Bypassed, or Not tracking.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if LaneStatus contains an undocumented value.
Escalate if the location remains Not tracking when it is expected to participate in sorter operation.
Do not change LaneStatus or other database values as part of this diagnostic.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: LaneStatus values are Active, Bypassed, and Not tracking; Active is open, Bypassed is closed, and Not tracking is excluded from use.

steps.title: Review KeepClose and TipperSelect when applicable
steps.purpose: Check location-specific closeout and tipper-selection configuration without misclassifying supported NULL values.
steps.instruction: In the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) location record, inspect KeepClose and TipperSelect when those configuration values are relevant to the location. Preserve source-supported NULL values for nullable fields, including applicable load-category or AGV-related values, rather than treating every NULL as an error.
steps.expected_result: KeepClose and TipperSelect are recorded when applicable, and nullable fields are distinguished from mapping or status faults.
steps.healthy_condition: The observed KeepClose and TipperSelect values are consistent with the location's documented use, while supported NULL values remain unchanged and are not automatically classified as faults.
steps.failure_condition: A relevant KeepClose or TipperSelect value conflicts with the expected location use, or a value is treated as an error solely because it is NULL.

actions.label: Check location configuration
actions.exact_action: Check KeepClose and TipperSelect for the location when those configuration values are relevant.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if a relevant KeepClose or TipperSelect value conflicts with the expected location mapping.
Do not escalate a nullable field solely because its value is NULL.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: KeepClose indicates whether a chute should remain closed after an exchange; TipperSelect identifies a specified tipper when applicable. The segment also states that some LoadCategory and AGV-related values are expected to be nullable.

success_criteria: The selected location row is present in the SorterSweeper Location Model.
LocationType is one of Sorter, Tipper, Hospital, or Induction and matches the intended station category.
LocationCellCode corresponds to the associated Station mapping.
LaneStatus is Active, Bypassed, or Not tracking and its operational meaning is recorded.
KeepClose and TipperSelect are reviewed when relevant without treating supported NULL values as faults.
No database or configuration values are changed.
healthy_conditions: The location row is available in WCS / Helix DB (SSMS).
Station, LocationType, and LocationCellCode identify a consistent mapping.
LaneStatus is a documented value: Active, Bypassed, or Not tracking.
Active is interpreted as open for use, Bypassed as closed, and Not tracking as excluded from use.
Nullable LoadCategory or AGV-related fields are not treated as faults solely because they are NULL.
failure_conditions: The expected location row is missing.
LocationType or LocationCellCode does not match the station mapping.
The location remains Not tracking when it is expected to participate in sorter operation.
A relevant KeepClose or TipperSelect value conflicts with the expected location use.
escalation_guidance: Escalate missing rows, station or cell-code mapping mismatches, and undocumented LaneStatus values to L3_support or the owning engineering team.
Escalate a location that remains Not tracking when it is expected to participate in sorter operation.
Include the observed location identity, Station, LocationCellCode, LocationType, LaneStatus, and relevant KeepClose or TipperSelect values in the escalation.
Do not make database or configuration changes during this read-only diagnostic.
